subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw expose a permanent after-compaction `ctx.api.resetSession` plugin contract, and if so should it support only `resetSession(reason?)` or also the unshipped key-based compatibility overload?
rationale: Current main has no such API, the related broad implementation was closed unmerged, and retaining compatibility for deployed external plugin code would intentionally create a public contract that repository policy does not let automation choose.

options.title: Approve one canonical call
options.body: Expose only current-session `resetSession(reason?)`, remove the key-based overload, and keep the lifecycle queue private to core.

options.title: Own both call forms
options.body: Approve the key-based overload as an explicit external compatibility contract with documentation and focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Reject the core API
options.body: Keep session reset out of hook context and require a different generic lifecycle seam or plugin-owned workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve one canonical call
recommendation.body: Expose only current-session `resetSession(reason?)`, remove the key-based overload, and keep the lifecycle queue private to core.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this person to the compaction, reset, and session-bookkeeping invariants affected by the API choice.
